title: Honua Sample Run Results v1
description: Shape of results/run-results.v1.json, written by scripts/run-samples.mjs and uploaded as a CI artifact. honua-evidence joins these envelopes by capability key (honua-io/honua-evidence#1/#3).

serverVersion.description: Best-effort; "unknown" when no authenticated version endpoint was reachable.

edition.description: Edition the runner was invoked with (scripts/run-samples.mjs --edition, default "community"). Samples whose manifest 'edition' exceeds this are recorded with outcome "skipped", never executed -- see docker/compose.pro.yml and the run-samples workflow's optional license secret.

outcome.description: "skipped" means the sample was never executed -- its manifest 'edition' exceeds the runner's --edition (see the top-level 'edition' field), e.g. a pro-gated sample run with no license secret configured.

error.description: Present when outcome is "fail" (the last attempt's failure message) or "skipped" (why it was skipped).

attempts.description: One entry per execution attempt (scripts/run-samples.mjs retries a failing sample once by default, HONUA_SAMPLE_MAX_ATTEMPTS env var). Absent when outcome is "skipped" -- a skipped sample is never attempted.

error.description: Present only when this attempt's outcome is "fail".

flaky.description: True only when the sample failed on an earlier attempt and then passed on retry (final outcome "pass" with attempts.length > 1). Absent (not false) when not flaky, so nightly summaries can filter on presence.
